anomalies.description: A man in a dark jacket (f3) reaches up toward the ceiling of the bus, then at f4 his foot is seen kicking outward through a window, followed by f5 showing the window shattered with his leg outside — indicating a violent struggle and breach of the vehicle.

A uniformed officer (f7) is shown aiming a handgun directly forward; frame f8 shows him with mouth open in shock or shout while still holding the weapon pointed, consistent with having just fired or being in the act of firing.

Simultaneous with the shooting, the man in the dark jacket (f7–f9) is seen violently moving inside the bus, with f8 showing him mid-motion near the shattered window and f9 showing him falling or being thrown backward—indicating active physical confrontation.

After the window breach, the man in the dark jacket (f10) is seen crouched outside the bus, appearing subdued or injured, while the officer remains inside in an aggressive posture (f11–f12), suggesting potential post-assault control or mistreatment of a vulnerable individual.
A man in a green jacket physically attacks two uniformed officers near a red bus; the officers attempt to defend themselves and subdue him, with visible grappling and pushing.

A man in a green jacket physically engages with a uniformed officer, appearing to grab or strike him while another officer rushes in; this is a mutual physical combat scenario.; A man in a dark jacket and jeans is engaged in a physical struggle with another man in a white uniform near the open door of a bus; they grapple, push, and one is forced to the ground.

A close-up shows a hand holding a revolver (f14), and in the next frame (f15), the man in green appears to be firing or has just fired the weapon at the officer, as indicated by the recoil posture and proximity of the gun to the officer’s torso.
After the officers are on the ground, the attacker continues to assault one officer who is lying helpless on the pavement, including striking and pressing down on him while holding a handgun.

After being subdued, the man in the white uniform lies on the road while the attacker in the dark jacket continues to press down on him; a second officer is also on the ground nearby, suggesting he is helpless and being assaulted.
The attacker in the dark jacket draws and points a handgun at the prone officer in the white uniform; the firearm is clearly visible in his hand and aimed.
Two individuals are engaged in close physical struggle; one is bent over the other in a grappling motion.

A second physical confrontation occurs: a man in a white shirt (possibly the same officer or another) is grappling with the attacker near the bus; they are locked in close combat, with visible struggle and force.; Two men are actively wrestling; one in a dark jacket has grabbed the other (in light uniform) by the collar/neck area in a clear combat grip.
A uniformed officer is on the ground, reaching for a weapon while another person looms over him; the officer appears restrained or subdued.

The uniformed officer is lying prone and appears helpless while being attacked by the man in the dark jacket, who uses force including choking and weapon control; the officer’s screams and inability to resist indicate abuse rather than mutual combat.

A man in a dark jacket physically subdues and struggles with a uniformed officer on the ground, involving grappling, choking, and weapon disarming; the officer is screaming throughout.; Two men are engaged in close physical struggle: one (in green jacket) grips the other (in light jacket) from behind while the latter grimaces and resists, suggesting mutual combat rather than one-sided abuse; however, the restrained man’s posture suggests limited capacity to fight back.

A close-up shows a hand holding a revolver pointed forward; though no muzzle flash or bullet is visible, the weapon is clearly aimed and the context strongly suggests an imminent or just-occurred discharge. Given the tight frame and lack of visual proof of firing, confidence is moderate.
A man in civilian clothing holds a revolver to the head of a screaming uniformed officer who is pinned down; the officer is clearly helpless and being threatened with lethal force.

A man in a green jacket is physically restraining and subduing another man in a light-colored jacket, who appears distressed and helpless; the restrained man is bent over and being held from behind, consistent with an attack on a non-resisting victim.
A uniformed officer repeatedly strikes a restrained individual lying on the ground with a baton while others hold him down.
An officer aims and fires a handgun; muzzle flash is not visible but the posture, grip, and recoil motion in frame f15 strongly indicate discharge.
